summary: The implementation successfully adds the Resend OTP feature with timer and attempt limiting. All core requirements are implemented including: two custom hooks for timer and attempt tracking using localStorage, countdown timer logic, attempt limiting (3 attempts per 10 minutes), and integration into LoginPage.tsx. However, the diff is truncated for LoginPage.tsx, making it impossible to verify styling details, toast notifications, and the complete UI implementation.
